racket_plan — DRIVE racket op

• Data kinds: table × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.racket_plan(v_in, omega_in, v_out, bp: 'dict', rp: 'dict', refine: 'int' = 8) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import racket; racket.racket_plan(v_in, omega_in, v_out, bp: 'dict', rp: 'dict', refine: 'int' = 8) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("racket_plan"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

望む v_out を出すラケットの法線 n と速度 v_r(法線方向)。摩擦 0 の閉形式 n ∝ v_out − v_in、v_r·n = |Δv|/(1+e) + v_in·n を初期値に、実際の衝突(摩擦・スピン込み)で refine 回反復。返り値 {"normal", "v_racket", "v_out_actual", "omega_out", "residual"}。Δv ≈ 0 なら ValueError。
